questions.stem: What is the difference between mechanical and chemical digestion?

options.text: Mechanical digestion uses enzymes; chemical digestion uses teeth
Mechanical digestion breaks food into smaller pieces physically; chemical digestion uses enzymes to break down large molecules
Mechanical digestion occurs in the stomach; chemical digestion occurs in the mouth
There is no difference; they are the same process

questions.explanation: Mechanical digestion physically breaks food into smaller pieces (e.g. by teeth or churning), while chemical digestion uses enzymes to break down large food molecules into smaller, soluble ones.
